articles.title: Ex-NFL star Peterson still in jail after DWI arrest
articles.summary: Former NFL running back Adrian Peterson remained jailed on Monday after being arrested a day earlier in a Houston suburb on charges of driving while intoxicated and unlawfully carrying a weapon.

articles.title: 'All went well': Skattebo undergoes ankle surgery
articles.summary: Giants rookie running back Cam Skattebo had surgery Sunday night on the dislocated ankle he suffered in Sunday's loss to the Eagles, and "all went well," coach Brian Daboll said during a Zoom call on Monday afternoon.

articles.title: Panthers likely to ditch RB shuffle, go with Dowdle
articles.summary: Panthers coach Dave Canales strongly suggested he will no longer alternate series between his running backs and instead will give Rico Dowdle a heavier workload.

articles.title: Bills fear DT Oliver has torn biceps, sources say
articles.summary: The Bills fear that standout defensive tackle Ed Oliver tore a biceps in Sunday's 40-9 victory over the Panthers and will be sidelined indefinitely, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Coen: Jags not trading second-year WR Thomas
articles.summary: The Jaguars are not going to trade receiver Brian Thomas Jr. despite the second-year player's struggles to start the season, head coach Liam Coen said Monday.

articles.title: Rams expect Nacua to return Sunday vs. Saints
articles.summary: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is expected to play Sunday against the Saints after spraining his left ankle in Week 6.

articles.summary: Veteran wide receiver Tyler Lockett, who was released by the Titans last week, is expected to sign with the Las Vegas Raiders, sources confirmed to ESPN.
